title.zh: 卷七 本紀第七: 世祖四
title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七: 世祖四 Volume 7 Annals 7: Shizu 4

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛丑朔，高麗國王王禃遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the xinchou new moon, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the xinchou new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys with greetings.

sentences.zh: 丙午，耶律鑄、廉希憲罷。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Yelü Zhu and Lian Xixian were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Yelü Zhu and Lian Xixian were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 立尚書省，罷制國用使司。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue was established, and the State Revenues Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue was established and the state revenues commission abolished.

sentences.zh: 以平章政事忽都答兒為中書左丞相，國子祭酒許衡為中書左丞，制國用使阿合馬平章尚書省事，同知制國用使司事張易同平章尚書省事，制國用使司副使張惠、簽制國用使司事李堯咨、麥術丁並參知尚書省事。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Hududar was made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Chancellor of the Imperial Academy Xu Heng was made Left Associate; State Revenues Commissioner Ahmad was made Grand Councillor of Ministry of Revenue affairs; Associate Controller of the State Revenues Commission Zhang Yi was made Concurrent Grand Councillor of Ministry of Revenue affairs; Deputy Commissioner of the State Revenues Commission Zhang Hui, Controller of the State Revenues Commission Li Yaozi, and Maimutding were all made Vice Grand Councillors of Ministry of Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillor Hududar became left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; imperial academy chancellor Xu Heng became left associate; state revenues commissioner Ahmad became grand councillor over Ministry of Revenue affairs; associate controller Zhang Yi became concurrent grand councillor over Ministry of Revenue affairs; and deputy commissioner Zhang Hui, controller Li Yaozi, and Maimutding all became vice grand councillors of Ministry of Revenue affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the moon infringed upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon infringed upon Bi.

sentences.zh: 敕諸投下官隸中書省。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that officials of all appanages be subordinate to the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed officials of every appanage under the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬子，敕驛卷無印者不許乘傳。

translations.literal: On renzi day, an edict ordered that post-relay documents without seals were not to be honored for travel.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict forbade travel on post relay unless the document bore an official seal.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，高麗國王王禃遣使來言：「比奉詔臣已復位，今從七百人入覲。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys to report: "Having lately received the edict, I have already been restored to the throne; I now wish to come in audience with seven hundred followers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys saying, "Since receiving the edict I have been restored to the throne, and I now wish to come to court with seven hundred followers.

sentences.zh: 」詔令從四百人來，余留之西京。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that four hundred be allowed to come; the remainder were to stay at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed four hundred to come; the rest were to remain at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔高麗西京內屬，改東寧府，畫慈悲嶺為界。

translations.literal: An edict brought Goryeo's Western Capital within direct control, renamed it Dongning Prefecture, and fixed Ciji Ridge as the border.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed Goryeo's Western Capital under direct rule, renamed it Dongning Prefecture, and drew the border at Ciji Ridge.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以蒙哥都為安撫高麗使，佩虎符，率兵戍其西境。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Menggudu was made Pacification Commissioner for Goryeo, granted a tiger tally, and ordered to lead troops to garrison its western border.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Menggudu was appointed pacification commissioner for Goryeo, given a tiger tally, and sent with troops to garrison the western border.

sentences.zh: 戊午，均、房州總管孫嗣擒宋統制朱興祖等。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Sun Si, zongguan of Jun and Fang Prefectures, captured Song commander-in-chief Zhu Xingzu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Sun Si, zongguan of Jun and Fang Prefectures, captured Song commander Zhu Xingzu and others.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賑兀魯吾民戶鈔。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, paper money was issued in relief to Ulugh civilian households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day paper money was issued to relieve Ulugh civilian households.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，定省、院、臺文移體式。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the formats for documents of the secretariat, commissions, and censorate were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the document formats of the secretariat, commissions, and censorate were standardized.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未朔，以前中書右丞相伯顏為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Second month, xinwei new moon: the former Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Bayan was made Deputy Privy Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the second month the former right chancellor Bayan was made deputy privy councillor.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，築昭應宮於高梁河。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Zhaoying Palace was built at Gaoliang River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhaoying Palace was built on the Gaoliang River.

sentences.zh: 丙子，帝御行宮，觀劉秉忠、孛羅、許衡及太常卿徐世隆所起朝儀，大悅，舉酒賜之。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the Emperor attended the traveling palace and viewed the court ritual drawn up by Liu Bingzhong, Boluo, Xu Heng, and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xu Shilong; he was greatly pleased and raised wine to grant them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor went to the traveling palace to watch the court ritual Liu Bingzhong, Boluo, Xu Heng, and Xu Shilong of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had devised. Greatly pleased, he raised a cup and rewarded them.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以歲饑罷修築宮城役夫。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, because of famine that year, corvée laborers building the palace city were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, citing famine that year, corvée labor on the palace city was halted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，置尚書省署。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, offices of the Ministry of Revenue were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day offices of the Ministry of Revenue were set up.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立紙甲局。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the Paper Armor Bureau was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the paper armor bureau was established.

sentences.zh: 申嚴畜牧損壞禾稼桑果之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on livestock damaging grain crops, mulberry fields, and fruit trees was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on livestock trampling grain, mulberry, and fruit was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，立司農司，以參知政事張文謙為卿，設四道巡行勸農司。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the Agriculture Commission was established, with Vice Grand Councillor Zhang Wenqian as its director; four circuit offices for touring farming encouragement were also set up.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the agriculture commission was established under vice grand councillor Zhang Wenqian, with four circuit offices to tour the countryside and encourage farming.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宋襄陽出步騎萬餘人、兵船百餘艘，來趣萬山堡，萬戶張弘範、千戶脫脫擊卻敗之，事聞，各賜金紋綾有差。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Song Xiangyang sent more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry and over one hundred warships toward Wanshan Fort; Wanhu Zhang Hongfan and Qianhu Tuotuo attacked, drove them back, and defeated them. When the report arrived, each was granted gold-patterned brocade in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Xiangyang sent more than ten thousand foot and horse soldiers and over one hundred warships toward Wanshan Fort. Wanhu Zhang Hongfan and qianhu Tuotuo beat them back and routed them. When word reached court, each was rewarded with gold-patterned brocade according to merit.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃來朝，求見皇子燕王，詔曰：「汝一國主也，見朕足矣。

translations.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court and asked to see Prince Yan; an edict stated: "You are the ruler of a state — seeing Us is enough.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court and asked to see Prince Yan. An edict replied, "You are king of a country; seeing the Emperor is enough.

sentences.zh: 」禃請以子愖見，從之。

translations.literal: " Chŏn asked that his son Chŏm be allowed an audience; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Chŏn asked that his son Chŏm be received in audience, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 詔諭禃曰：「汝內附在後，故班諸王下。

translations.literal: An edict addressed Chŏn: "Because your submission came later, your rank is below that of the princes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Chŏn, "Because you submitted later, your place ranks below the princes.

sentences.zh: 我太祖時亦都護先附，即令齒諸王上，阿思蘭後附，故班其下，卿宜知之。

translations.literal: In the time of Our Grand Ancestor, Protector Yidu submitted first and was therefore ranked above the princes; Aslan submitted later and was ranked below them — you should understand this.
translations.idiomatic: In the Grand Ancestor's day Protector Yidu submitted first and was ranked above the princes; Aslan came later and was ranked below them. You should understand this.

sentences.zh: 」又詔令國王頭輦哥等舉軍入高麗舊京，以脫朵兒、焦天翼為其國達魯花赤，護送禃還國。

translations.literal: " Another edict ordered Prince Touliangge and others to lead troops into Goryeo's old capital; Tuoduo'er and Jiao Tianyi were made darughachi of that country, and Chŏn was escorted home.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered Prince Touliangge and others to march into Goryeo's old capital. Tuoduo'er and Jiao Tianyi were made darughachi of the country, and Chŏn was escorted home.

sentences.zh: 仍下詔：「林衍廢立，罪不可赦。

translations.literal: A further edict was issued: "Lin Yan's deposition and enthronement are crimes that cannot be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: A further edict declared, "Lin Yan's deposition and enthronement are unpardonable crimes.

sentences.zh: 安慶公淐本非得已，在所寬宥。

translations.literal: Prince of Anqing Chŏ had no choice in the matter and is to be broadly forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Anqing Chŏ acted under compulsion and is to be broadly forgiven.

sentences.zh: 有能執送衍者，雖舊在其黨，亦必重增官秩。

translations.literal: Whoever can seize and deliver Yan, even if formerly in his faction, will surely receive a great increase in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever captures Yan and delivers him up, even if once among his faction, will receive a substantial promotion.

sentences.zh: 」世子愖奏乞隨朝及尚主，不許，命隨其父還國。

translations.literal: " Crown Prince Chŏm memorialized asking to remain at court and marry an imperial princess; this was not granted, and he was ordered to return with his father.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Chŏm asked to remain at court and marry an imperial princess. The request was refused, and he was ordered to return with his father.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, gengzi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the third month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 改河南等路及陜西五路西蜀四川、東京等路行中書省為行尚書省。

translations.literal: The branch secretariats of Henan and other routes, the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, Sichuan, and Dongjing and other routes were changed to branch ministries of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Branch secretariats in Henan and other routes, the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, Sichuan, and Dongjing and other routes were converted to branch ministries of revenue.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「河西和糴，應僧人、豪官、富民一例行之。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials stated: "For government grain purchases in Hexi, Buddhist clergy, powerful officials, and wealthy households should all be treated alike.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials reported that in Hexi government grain purchases should apply equally to Buddhist clergy, powerful officials, and wealthy households.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor traveled to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，浚武清縣御河。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the imperial canal at Wuqing County was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the imperial canal at Wuqing County was dredged.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，定醫官品從。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the ranks of medical officials were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the ranks of medical officials were fixed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，益都、登、萊蝗旱，詔減其今年包銀之半。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Yidu, Deng, and Lai suffered locusts and drought; an edict reduced this year's household silver levy by half.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day locusts and drought struck Yidu, Deng, and Lai; an edict cut this year's household silver levy in half.

sentences.zh: 阿術與劉整言：「圍守襄陽，必當以教水軍、造戰艦為先務。

translations.literal: Aju and Liu Zheng stated: "To besiege and hold Xiangyang, training the navy and building war vessels must come first.
translations.idiomatic: Aju and Liu Zheng argued that to hold Xiangyang under siege, training the navy and building war vessels had to come first.

sentences.zh: 」詔許之。

translations.literal: " An edict granted this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 教水軍七萬餘人，造戰艦五千艘。

translations.literal: More than seventy thousand men were trained for the navy, and five thousand war vessels were built.
translations.idiomatic: More than seventy thousand men were trained for the navy and five thousand war vessels built.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，檀州隕黑霜二夕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renyang day: in Tan Prefecture black frost fell for two nights.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang day in the fourth month of summer black frost fell at Tan Prefecture for two nights.

sentences.zh: 設諸路蒙古字學教授。

translations.literal: Professors of Mongol script schools were appointed on all routes.
translations.idiomatic: Professors were appointed for Mongol script schools on every route.

sentences.zh: 敕：「諸路達魯花赤子弟蔭敘充散府諸州達魯花赤，其散府諸州子弟充諸縣達魯花赤，諸縣子弟充巡檢。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "On all routes, sons of darughachi are to inherit appointment as darughachi of scattered prefectures and subordinate prefectures; sons of darughachi of scattered prefectures and subordinate prefectures are to fill county darughachi posts; and sons of county darughachi are to fill patrol-inspector posts."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that on every route sons of darughachi should inherit posts as darughachi of scattered prefectures and subordinate prefectures, sons of those darughachi should fill county darughachi posts, and sons of county darughachi should become patrol inspectors.

sentences.zh: 」改御史臺典事為都事。

translations.literal: The Censorate clerk was changed to secretary.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate clerk's title was changed to secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸未，定軍官等級，萬戶、總管、千戶、百戶、總把以軍士為差。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, military officer grades were fixed: wanhu, zongguan, qianhu, baihu, and zongba were differentiated by number of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day military officer grades were fixed: wanhu, zongguan, qianhu, baihu, and zongba were ranked by the number of soldiers under command.

sentences.zh: 己丑，省終南縣入盩厔，復真定贊皇縣、太原樂平縣。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Zhongnan County was merged into Zhouzhi; Zanhuang County of Zhending and Leping County of Taiyuan were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhongnan County was merged into Zhouzhi, and Zanhuang County in Zhending and Leping County in Taiyuan were restored.

sentences.zh: 高麗行省遣使來言：「權臣林衍死，其子惟茂擅襲令公位，為尚書宋宗禮所殺。

translations.literal: The Goryeo Branch Secretariat sent envoys to report: "The powerful minister Lin Yan is dead; his son Weimao seized the Commandery Duke's post on his own authority and was killed by Minister Song Zongli.
translations.idiomatic: The Goryeo branch secretariat sent envoys reporting that powerful minister Lin Yan was dead, his son Weimao had seized the commandery duke's post on his own authority, and Minister Song Zongli had killed him.

sentences.zh: 島中民皆出降，已遷之舊京。

translations.literal: The people on the island have all surrendered and have already been moved to the old capital.
translations.idiomatic: The island's people had all surrendered and were already being moved to the old capital.

sentences.zh: 衍黨裴仲孫等復集余眾，立禃庶族承化侯為王，竄入珍島。」

translations.literal: Yan's faction, Pei Zhongsun and others, again gathered the remaining forces, enthroned a collateral kinsman of Chŏn, the Marquis of Chenghua, as king, and fled into Jin Island."
translations.idiomatic: Yan's followers, Pei Zhongsun and others, rallied the remnant forces, enthroned Chŏn's collateral kinsman the Marquis of Chenghua as king, and fled to Jin Island."

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，懷州河內縣大雨雹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinchou day: Henan County of Huai Prefecture suffered heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the fifth month Henan County in Huai Prefecture was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，陜西僉省也速帶兒、嚴忠範與東西川統軍司率兵及宋兵戰於嘉定、重慶、釣魚山、馬湖江，皆敗之，拔三寨，擒都統牛宣，俘獲人民及馬牛戰艦無算。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat officials Yesudai'er and Yan Zhongfan, together with the eastern and western Chuan army commands, led troops against Song forces at Jiading, Chongqing, Diaoyu Mountain, and the Ma River; all were defeated, three stockades were taken, commander Niu Xuan was captured, and captives of people, horses, cattle, and war vessels were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Shaanxi branch officials Yesudai'er and Yan Zhongfan, with the eastern and western Chuan army commands, fought Song forces at Jiading, Chongqing, Diaoyu Mountain, and the Ma River, defeated them all, took three stockades, captured commander Niu Xuan, and seized untold numbers of people, horses, cattle, and war vessels.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，威州汝鳳川番族八千戶內附，其酋長來朝，授宣命，賜金符。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, eight thousand households of the Rufeng River Fan tribes of Weizhou submitted; their chieftains came to court, received imperial patents, and were granted gold tallies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day eight thousand households of the Rufeng River Fan tribes in Weizhou submitted; their chieftains came to court, received imperial patents, and were given gold tallies.

sentences.zh: 丁未，東京路饑，兼運糧造船勞役，免今年絲銀十之三。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the Dongjing Route suffered famine and was also worn down by grain transport and shipbuilding labor; this year's silk and silver levies were remitted by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day famine struck the Dongjing route, which was also exhausted by grain transport and shipbuilding labor; this year's silk and silver levies were cut by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 以同知樞密院事合答為平章政事。

translations.literal: Associate Privy Councillor Heda was made Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Associate privy councillor Heda was made grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復平灤路撫寧縣，以海山、昌黎入之。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Funing County of Pingluan Route was restored, with Haishan and Changli attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Funing County in Pingluan Route was restored, with Haishan and Changli placed under it.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，括天下戶。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, households throughout the realm were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day households throughout the realm were registered.

sentences.zh: 尚書省臣言：「諸路課程，歲銀五萬錠，恐疲民力，宜減十分之一。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials stated: "Annual revenue from all routes is fifty thousand ingots of silver; we fear this will exhaust the people — it should be reduced by one-tenth.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials reported that annual revenue from all routes totaled fifty thousand ingots of silver and feared this exhausted the people; it should be cut by one-tenth.

sentences.zh: 運司官吏俸祿，宜與民官同，其院務官量給工食，仍禁所司多取於民，歲終，較其增損而加黜陟。

translations.literal: Salaries of transport commission officials should match those of civilian officials; depot officials should receive measured rations, and offices were forbidden to take excess from the people. At year's end gains and losses would be compared and promotions and demotions applied.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commission salaries should match civilian officials'; depot officials should receive measured rations, and offices were forbidden to overcharge the people. At year's end results would be compared and officials promoted or demoted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 上都地裏遙遠，商旅往來不易，特免收稅以優之，惟市易莊宅、奴婢、孳畜，例收契本工墨之費。

translations.literal: Shangdu lies far inland and travel for merchants is difficult; taxes are specially waived to favor them, except that for market trade in houses, land, slaves, and livestock the usual deed and stamp fees are collected.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shangdu lay far inland and travel was hard for merchants, taxes there were specially waived, except that market trade in houses, land, slaves, and livestock still paid the usual deed and stamp fees.

sentences.zh: 管民官遷轉，以三十月為一考，數於變易，人心茍且，自今請以六十月遷轉。

translations.literal: Transfers of civilian officials came every thirty months; with such frequent change minds grew careless — henceforth transfers are requested at sixty months.
translations.idiomatic: Civilian officials had rotated every thirty months, and the constant change bred carelessness; henceforth transfers were set at sixty months.

sentences.zh: 諸王遣使取索諸物及鋪馬等事，自今並以文移，毋得口傳教令。

translations.literal: When princes send envoys to demand goods, relay horses, and the like, from now on written documents are required; oral commands are not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When princes sent envoys to demand goods, relay horses, and the like, written documents would henceforth be required and oral commands forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 改宣徽院為光祿司，秩正三品，以宣徽使線真為光祿使。

translations.literal: The Palace Provision Commission was changed to the Office of Imperial Entertainments, rank 3a; Palace Provision Commissioner Xianzhen was made Director of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: The palace provision commission became the Office of Imperial Entertainments, rank 3a, with palace provision commissioner Xianzhen as its director.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命樞密院閱實軍數。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the Privy Council was ordered to verify troop numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Privy Council was ordered to verify troop numbers.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，東平府進瑞麥，一莖二穗、三穗、五穗者各一本。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Dongping Prefecture presented auspicious wheat — one stalk each bearing two ears, three ears, and five ears.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Dongping Prefecture presented auspicious wheat, one stalk each with two, three, and five ears.

sentences.zh: 省中都打捕鷹坊總管府入工部。

translations.literal: The Capital Falconry and Hunting Commission was merged into the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The capital falconry and hunting commission was merged into the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 大名、東平等路桑蠶皆災，南京、河南等路蝗，減今年銀絲十之三。

translations.literal: Silkworms and mulberry were ruined in Daming, Dongping, and other routes; locusts struck Nanjing, Henan, and other routes; this year's silver and silk levies were reduced by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Silkworms and mulberry failed in Daming, Dongping, and other routes, and locusts struck Nanjing, Henan, and other routes; this year's silver and silk levies were cut by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，敕西夏中興市馬五百匹。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingzi day: an edict ordered purchase of five hundred horses at the Zhongxing market in Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the sixth month an edict ordered five hundred horses purchased at the Zhongxing market in Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，敕：「戍軍還，有乏食及病者，令所過州城村坊主者給飲食醫藥。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, an edict stated: "When garrison troops return, those lacking food or falling ill are to be given food and medicine by the heads of the states, cities, villages, and wards they pass through.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered that when garrison troops returned, those without food or those who fell ill were to receive food and medicine from the heads of the states, cities, villages, and wards they passed through.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，罷各路洞冶總管府，以轉運司兼領。

translations.literal: " On dinghai day, smelting directorates on all routes were abolished, and transport commissions were ordered to administer them concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day smelting directorates on all routes were abolished and their duties assigned to transport commissions.

sentences.zh: 徙謙州甲匠於松山，給牛具。

translations.literal: Artisans of Qian Prefecture were moved to Songshan and given oxen and tools.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans of Qian Prefecture were moved to Songshan and given oxen and tools.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子南木合馬六千、牛三千、羊一萬。

translations.literal: Prince Namuhem was granted six thousand horses, three thousand oxen, and ten thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Namuhem received six thousand horses, three thousand oxen, and ten thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 賜北邊戍軍馬二萬、牛一千、羊五萬。

translations.literal: Northern frontier garrison troops were granted twenty thousand horses, one thousand oxen, and fifty thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Northern frontier garrison troops received twenty thousand horses, one thousand oxen, and fifty thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立籍田大都東南郊。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, sacrificial fields were established southeast of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day sacrificial fields were established southeast of the capital.

sentences.zh: 禁民擅入宋境剽掠。

translations.literal: Private entry into Song territory for plunder was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Private raids into Song territory were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，設上林署。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, xinchou day: the Superior Forest Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the seventh month of autumn the Superior Forest Office was established.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜諸王拜答寒印及海青、金符二。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Prince Baidaham was granted a seal and two each of gyrfalcon and gold tallies.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Baidaham received a seal and two gyrfalcons and two gold tallies.

sentences.zh: 庚申，初給軍官俸。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, salaries for military officers were first granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day military officers received salaries for the first time.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，簽諸道回回軍。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Muslim troops on all circuits were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Muslim troops on every circuit were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，閱實諸路炮手戶。

translations.literal: On yichou day, catapult-household registers on all routes were verified.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day catapult-household registers on every route were verified.

sentences.zh: 都元帥也速帶兒等略地光州，敗宋兵於金剛臺。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Yesudai'er and others raided Guang Prefecture and defeated Song troops at Jingang Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Grand marshal Yesudai'er and others raided Guang Prefecture and defeated Song troops at Jingang Terrace.

sentences.zh: 以遼東開元等路總管府兼本路轉運司事。

translations.literal: The Liaodong Kaiyuan and other route zongguan offices were ordered to administer their route transport commissions concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaodong Kaiyuan and other route zongguan offices were ordered to run their route transport commissions concurrently.

sentences.zh: 山東諸路旱蝗。

translations.literal: Drought and locusts struck Shandong routes.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and locusts struck the Shandong routes.

sentences.zh: 免軍戶田租，戍邊者給糧。

translations.literal: Military-household land rent was remitted, and frontier garrison troops were issued grain.
translations.idiomatic: Land rent for military households was remitted, and frontier garrison troops were issued grain.

sentences.zh: 命達魯花赤兀良吉帶給上都扈從畋獵糧。

translations.literal: Darughachi Uryangqadai was ordered to issue grain for the hunting retinue at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Darughachi Uryangqadai was ordered to issue grain for the hunting retinue at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰朔，築環城以逼襄陽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuchen new moon: encircling walls were built to press Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the eighth month encircling walls were built to tighten the siege of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賑應昌府饑。

translations.literal: On jisi day, famine in Yingchang Prefecture was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day famine relief was issued in Yingchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 諸王拜答寒部曲告饑，命有車馬者徙居黃忽兒玉良之地，計口給糧，無車馬者就食肅、沙、甘州。

translations.literal: Prince Baidaham's retainers reported famine; those with horses and carts were ordered to move to Huanghu'er Yuliang and receive grain by head count, while those without horses and carts were to find food in Su, Sha, and Gan Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Baidaham's retainers reported famine. Those with horses and carts were moved to Huanghu'er Yuliang and given grain by head count; those without were sent to find food in Su, Sha, and Gan Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，隆興府總管昔剌斡脫以盜用官錢罷。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Longxing Prefecture zongguan Cila Ot was dismissed for embezzling government funds.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Cila Ot, zongguan of Longxing Prefecture, was dismissed for embezzling government funds.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以御史大夫塔察兒同知樞密院事，御史中丞帖只為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Censor-in-Chief Tachar was made Associate Privy Councillor, and Vice Censor-in-Chief Tiezhi was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day censor-in-chief Tachar became associate privy councillor, and vice censor-in-chief Tiezhi became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 高麗世子王愖來賀聖誕節。

translations.literal: Goryeo Crown Prince Wang Chŏm came to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm came to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，設應昌府官吏。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, officials of Yingchang Prefecture were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day officials were established for Yingchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，保定路霖雨，傷禾稼。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Baoding Route suffered prolonged rain that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day prolonged rain in Baoding Route damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，敕僧、道、也裏可溫有家室不持戒律者，占籍為民。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengzi day: an edict ordered that Buddhist clergy, Daoist clergy, and Nestorian Christians who kept wives and families and did not observe discipline be registered as civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month an edict ordered Buddhist clergy, Daoist clergy, and Nestorian Christians who kept wives and families and ignored discipline to be registered as civilians.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the moon infringed upon Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon infringed upon Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，括河西戶口，定田稅。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Hexi households were registered and field taxes fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Hexi households were registered and field taxes fixed.

sentences.zh: 宋將範文虎以兵船二千艘來援襄陽，阿術、合答、劉整率兵逆戰於灌子灘，殺掠千餘人，獲船三十艘，文虎引退。

translations.literal: Song General Fan Wenhu came with two thousand warships to relieve Xiangyang; Aju, Heda, and Liu Zheng led troops to meet them in battle at Guanzitan, killed and plundered more than one thousand men, captured thirty vessels, and Wenhu withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Song general Fan Wenhu came with two thousand warships to relieve Xiangyang. Aju, Heda, and Liu Zheng met him at Guanzitan, killed and plundered more than one thousand men, captured thirty vessels, and Wenhu withdrew.

sentences.zh: 西京饑，敕諸王阿只吉所部就食太原。

translations.literal: Xijing suffered famine; an edict ordered Prince Azhiji's forces to seek food at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: With famine at Xijing, an edict sent Prince Azhiji's forces to forage at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 山東饑，敕益都、濟南酒稅以十之二收糧。

translations.literal: Shandong suffered famine; an edict ordered that two-tenths of the wine taxes of Yidu and Jinan be used to collect grain.
translations.idiomatic: With famine in Shandong, an edict directed that twenty percent of Yidu and Jinan wine revenues be turned into grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，敕兩省以已奏事報御史臺。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wuchen new moon; an edict ordered both secretariats to report submitted matters to the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the tenth month of winter, both secretariats were ordered to report all submitted business to the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Venus transgressed You Zhifa.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Venus crossed You Zhifa (Right Law Enforcer).

sentences.zh: 癸酉，敕宗廟祭祀祝文，書以國字。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, an edict ordered that ancestral temple sacrifice prayer texts be written in the national script.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict required ancestral temple sacrifice prayers to be written in the national script.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宋人攻莒州。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Song troops attacked Juzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Song forces attacked Juzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the court offered sacrifice at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以南京、河南兩路旱蝗，減今年差賦十之六。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, because of drought and locusts in the Nanjing and Henan circuits, this year's tax levies were reduced by six-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day drought and locusts in the Nanjing and Henan circuits brought a sixty-percent reduction in this year's levies.

sentences.zh: 發清、滄鹽二十四萬斤，轉南京米十萬石，並給襄陽軍。

translations.literal: Twenty-four wan jin of salt from Qing and Cang were dispatched, one hundred thousand shi of Nanjing rice were transported, and both were given to the Xiangyang army.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched 240,000 jin of salt from Qing and Cang, transported 100,000 shi of Nanjing rice, and sent both to the Xiangyang army.

sentences.zh: 己丑，敕來年太廟牲牢，勿用豢豕，以野豕代之，時果勿市，取之內園。

translations.literal: On jichou day, an edict ordered that next year's ancestral temple sacrificial animals not use domesticated pigs but use wild boar instead, and that seasonal fruits not be bought from the market but taken from the inner garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict directed that next year's temple sacrifices use wild boar instead of domestic pigs and that seasonal fruit come from the imperial gardens rather than the market.

sentences.zh: 車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 降興中府為州。

translations.literal: Xingzhong Superior Prefecture was reduced to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhong Superior Prefecture was downgraded to a regular prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賑山東淄萊路饑。

translations.literal: Famine relief was provided to Zilai Circuit in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was issued to Zilai circuit in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，熒惑犯太微西垣上將。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renyin day; Mars transgressed the Western Rampart General in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the eleventh month Mars crossed the Western Rampart General in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 壬子，河西諸郡諸王頓舍，僧、民協力供給。

translations.literal: On renzi day, various princes made encampments throughout Hexi, and monks and common people jointly supplied provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day various princes encamped throughout Hexi, with monks and civilians jointly supplying their needs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕益兵二千，合前所發軍為六千，屯田高麗，以忻都及前左壁總帥史樞，並為高麗金州等處經略使，佩虎符，領屯田事。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict added two thousand troops; together with the armies previously dispatched the total was six thousand for garrison farming in Goryeo. Xindu and former Left Wing commander Shi Shu were both made Military Commissioners of Goryeo's Jin Prefecture and other places, granted tiger tallies, and put in charge of garrison-farming affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day two thousand more troops were ordered, bringing the total sent for garrison farming in Goryeo to six thousand. Xindu and former Left Wing commander Shi Shu were both appointed military commissioners of Goryeo's Jin Prefecture region, given tiger tallies, and placed in charge of garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 仍詔諭高麗國王立侍儀司。

translations.literal: An edict also instructed the King of Goryeo to establish a Ceremonial Protocol Office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered the Goryeo king to establish a ceremonial protocol office.

sentences.zh: 安南國王陳光丙遣使來貢，優詔答之。

translations.literal: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys bearing tribute; a generous edict replied to them.
translations.idiomatic: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent tribute envoys and received a generous edict in reply.

sentences.zh: 復賑淄萊路饑。

translations.literal: Famine relief was again provided to Zilai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Zilai circuit received famine relief again.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯朔，高麗世子王愖還，賜王禃至元八年曆。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, dingmao new moon; the Goryeo crown prince Wang Sim returned, and Wang Chon was granted the Zhiyuan eighth-year calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the intercalary month the Goryeo crown prince Wang Sim returned, and King Wang Chon was granted the eighth-year Zhiyuan calendar.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禁繒段織日月龍虎，及以龍犀飾馬鞍者。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, brocade woven with sun, moon, dragon, and tiger designs was forbidden, as was decorating saddles with rhinoceros horn.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day brocade bearing sun, moon, dragon, and tiger motifs was banned, as was rhinoceros-horn saddle decoration.

sentences.zh: 己巳，給河西行省鈔萬錠，以充歲費。

translations.literal: On jisi day, ten thousand ingots of paper money were given to the Hexi Branch Secretariat to meet annual expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Hexi branch secretariat received ten thousand ingots of paper money for its annual expenses.

sentences.zh: 以義州隸婆娑府。

translations.literal: Yizhou was placed under Pansha Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou was placed under Pansha Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔諭西夏提刑按察司管民官，禁僧徒冒據民田。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, an edict addressed the civil officials under the Western Xia Circuit Intendant and Surveillance Commission, forbidding monks from illegally occupying civilian farmland.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict directed Western Xia's surveillance officials over civil administrators to forbid monks from illegally occupying civilian farmland.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，申明勸課農桑賞罰之法。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the regulations for rewards and punishments in promoting agriculture and sericulture were clarified.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day regulations for rewarding and punishing agricultural promotion were clarified.

sentences.zh: 詔設諸路脫脫禾孫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered tuotuohesun established on every route.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered relay inspectors (tuotuohesun) established on every route.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申朔，改司農司為大司農司，添設巡行勸農使、副各四員，以御史中丞孛羅兼大司農卿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingchen new moon; the Directorate of Agriculture was changed to the Grand Directorate of Agriculture, with four additional Traveling Agricultural Promotion Commissioners and four deputies added, and Censorate Vice Director Boluo was made concurrent Grand Director of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the twelfth month the Directorate of Agriculture was upgraded to the Grand Directorate of Agriculture, with four additional traveling agricultural promotion commissioners and four deputies; Censorate Vice Director Boluo was also made grand director of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 安童言孛羅以臺臣兼領，前無此例。

translations.literal: Antong said that Boluo's concurrent appointment as a censorate official had no precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Antong observed that Boluo's concurrent appointment as both a censorate official and agricultural director had no precedent.

sentences.zh: 有旨：「司農非細事，朕深諭此，其令孛羅總之。

translations.literal: An imperial directive stated: "Agricultural affairs are no small matter; I understand this deeply — let Boluo oversee them."
translations.idiomatic: An imperial directive read, "Agricultural affairs are no small matter; I understand this well — let Boluo take overall charge."

sentences.zh: 」命陜西等路宣撫使趙良弼為秘書監，充國信使，使日本。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Zhao Liangbi of Shaanxi and other routes was made Director of the Imperial Library and appointed State Envoy to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Liangbi, pacification commissioner of Shaanxi and other routes, was made director of the imperial library and appointed state envoy to Japan.

sentences.zh: 敕歲祀太社、太稷、風師、雨師、雷師。

translations.literal: An edict ordered annual sacrifice to the Grand Community Altar, the Grand Grain Altar, and the Wind, Rain, and Thunder Lords.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered annual sacrifices to the Grand Community Altar, the Grand Grain Altar, and the Wind, Rain, and Thunder Lords.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，徙懷孟新民千八百餘戶居河西。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, more than eighteen hundred newly resettled households from Huaimeng were moved to settle west of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day more than eighteen hundred newly resettled households from Huaimeng were relocated west of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，升御史大夫秩正二品。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the rank of Censor-in-Chief was raised to second grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the censor-in-chief's rank was raised to second grade.

sentences.zh: 降河南韶州為澠池縣。

translations.literal: Shaozhou in Henan was reduced to Mianchi County.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou in Henan was downgraded to Mianchi County.

sentences.zh: 宋重慶制置朱禩孫遣諜者持書榜來誘安撫張大悅等，大悅不發封，並諜者送致東川統軍司。

translations.literal: Zhu Xisu, military commissioner of Song Chongqing, sent spies bearing letters and placards to induce Pacification Commissioner Zhang Dayue and others; Dayue did not break the seals and sent the spies together with their documents to the Eastern Sichuan Military Command.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xisu, Song military commissioner of Chongqing, sent spies with letters and placards to win over pacification commissioner Zhang Dayue and others; Dayue left the seals unbroken and sent the spies and their documents to the Eastern Sichuan military command.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金齒、驃國三部酋長阿匿福、勒丁、阿匿爪來內附，獻馴象三、馬十九匹。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the chieftains Anuofu, Leding, and Anuzhao of the three tribes of Jinyu and Piaoguo submitted, presenting three tame elephants and nineteen horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day chieftains Anuofu, Leding, and Anuzhao of the three Jinyu and Piaoguo tribes submitted, presenting three tame elephants and nineteen horses.

sentences.zh: 己酉，魚通路知府高曳失獲宋諜者，詔賞之。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Yuy Road Prefect Gao Yuyishi captured a Song spy; an edict rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yuy Road prefect Gao Yuyishi captured a Song spy and was rewarded by edict.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以都水監隸大司農司。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the Directorate of Waterways was placed under the Grand Directorate of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the directorate of waterways was placed under the grand directorate of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 以諸王伯忽兒為劄魯忽赤之長。

translations.literal: Prince Bohu'er was made chief of the Jarghuchi.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Bohu'er was made chief of the jarghuchi.

sentences.zh: 建大護國仁王寺於高良河。

translations.literal: The Great State-Protecting Benevolent King Temple was built at Gaoliang River.
translations.idiomatic: The Great State-Protecting Benevolent King Temple was built on the Gaoliang River.

sentences.zh: 敕更定僧服色。

translations.literal: An edict revised the regulations for Buddhist monastic vestment colors.
translations.idiomatic: An edict revised regulations for Buddhist monastic vestment colors.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百九十二萬九千四百四十九。

translations.literal: That year, registered households throughout the realm numbered one million nine hundred twenty-nine thousand four hundred forty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: That year registered households throughout the realm totaled 1,929,449.

sentences.zh: 賜先朝后妃及諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Former empresses and consorts and the various princes were granted gold, silver, currency, and silk according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Former empresses and consorts and the various princes received gold, silver, currency, and silk as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 斷死刑四十四人。

translations.literal: Forty-four persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-four persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月乙丑朔，高麗國王王禃遣其秘書監樸恒、郎將崔有淹來賀，兼奉歲貢。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, yichou new moon; King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his Secretariat Director Bak Heng and Lang Jiang Cui Youyan to offer congratulations and deliver the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the yichou new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his secretariat director Bak Heng and lang jiang Cui Youyan with greetings and the annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the moon transgressed Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon crossed Bi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以同僉河南等路行中書省事阿裏海牙參知尚書省事。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Alihaiya, associate intendant of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Alihaiya, associate intendant of the Henan branch secretariat, was made vice director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「前有旨令臣與樞密院、御史臺議河南行省阿裏伯等所置南陽等處屯田，臣等以為凡屯田人戶，皆內地中產之民，遠徙失業，宜還之本籍。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "There was formerly an edict ordering us to deliberate with the Privy Council and Censorate on the garrison-farming fields established by Alibo and others at Nanyang and elsewhere in the Henan Branch Secretariat. We consider that all garrison-farming households are productive commoners from the interior who, moved far away, lose their livelihoods, and should be returned to their original domiciles.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials reported, "We were formerly ordered to consult the Privy Council and Censorate on the garrison-farming fields Alibo and others had set up at Nanyang and elsewhere in Henan. We hold that garrison-farming households are productive inland commoners who lose their livelihoods when moved far away and should be returned to their original domiciles.

sentences.zh: 其南京、南陽、歸德等民賦，自今悉折輸米糧，貯於便近地，以給襄陽軍食。

translations.idiomatic: Civilian levies from Nanjing, Nanyang, Guide, and other places should henceforth be converted to grain payments, stored at convenient nearby sites, to feed the Xiangyang army.

sentences.zh: 前所屯田，阿裏伯自以無效引伏，宜令州郡募民耕佃。

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 史天澤告老，不允。

translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianze asked to retire; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 敕：「前築都城，徙居民三百八十二戶，計其直償之。

sentences.zh: 」設樞密院斷事官。

translations.literal: Judicial officials of the Privy Council were established.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial officials were established at the Privy Council.

translations.literal: Wuduman was dispatched to lead Mongol troops to garrison Tangdang in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Wuduman was sent to lead Mongol troops garrisoning Tangdang in the west.

translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Gu Ruren and Fei Zhengyin put state secrets into writing and plotted to send Cui Jichun, Jia Kaoshan, and Lu Kun into Song territory; when the plot was exposed they were fully investigated. sentences.zh: 壬辰，敕：「諸路鰥寡孤獨疾病不能自存者，官給廬舍、薪米。

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "On every route, widows, orphans, the solitary, the aged, and the sick who cannot support themselves shall receive government lodging and provisions."

sentences.zh: 」高麗國王王禃遣使奉表，為世子愖請昏。

translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys with a memorial requesting marriage for crown prince Wang Sim.

sentences.zh: 詔禁邊將受賂放軍及科斂。

translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade frontier generals from taking bribes to release soldiers or imposing illegal levies.

sentences.zh: 賑北京、益都饑。

translations.literal: Famine relief was provided to Beijing and Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was issued to Beijing and Yidu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未朔，定民間婚聘禮幣，貴賤有差。

translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the second month marriage betrothal gifts for commoners were regulated, with distinctions by rank.

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day more than twenty-eight thousand commoners from the Central Capital, Zhending, Shuntian, Hejian, and Pingluan were mobilized to build the palace city.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷諸路轉運司入總管府。

translations.idiomatic: On jihai day transport commissioners on every route were abolished and merged into circuit chief commissions.

sentences.zh: 以尚書省奏定條畫頒天下。

translations.literal: The regulations drawn up by the Ministry of Works and submitted by the Ministry were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations drawn up by the Ministry of Works and approved by the Ministry were promulgated throughout the realm.

translations.literal: The Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat was moved to Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi-Sichuan branch secretariat was moved to Xingyuan.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Yesudai'er of the Sichuan branch secretariat reported, "Famine has lately brought a great increase in banditry; harsher punishment should be applied."

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ministers to deliberate; Antong argued, "Executing all strong and petty thieves alike would probably be inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 罪至死者，仍舊待命。

translations.idiomatic: Cases warranting death should still await imperial approval as before."

translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bi, left vice director of the Central Secretariat and administrator of branch ministry affairs in Dongjing and other routes, was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，添設監察御史六員。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, six additional Supervising Censors were added.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day six additional supervising censors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 命忽都答兒持詔招諭高麗林衍余黨裴仲孫。

translations.idiomatic: Hududar was ordered to carry an edict winning over Pei Zhongsun, a remnant of Lin Yan's Goryeo faction.

translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Baoheding, regional commander-in-chief of pacification at Dali, Prince Tutor Kuokuodai, and others conspired to poison the Prince of Yunnan; Huonichi and Cao Zhen exposed the plot. Baoheding, Kuokuodai, Alawading, and Yisufu were all executed; Cao Zhen, Huonichi, and the witnesses were rewarded with gold and silver in varying amounts.

translations.literal: Three hundred men of the Shazhou and Guazhou falcon offices were conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred falconers from Shazhou and Guazhou were conscripted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔以治事日程諭中外官吏。

translations.literal: On wushen day, an edict promulgated administrative schedules to officials within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict issued administrative schedules to officials throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 敕往畏吾兒地市米萬石。

translations.literal: An edict ordered ten thousand shi of rice purchased in the Uighur markets.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered purchase of ten thousand shi of rice in the Uighur markets.

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the prohibition on Eastern Sichuan well salt was strictly reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the ban on Eastern Sichuan well salt was sharply reinforced.

translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day military officers were ordered to carry gold and silver tally tokens; tokens held by civilian officials and artisans were confiscated and not reissued.

sentences.zh: 敕海青符用太祖皇帝御署。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that sea-eagle tally tokens use the founding emperor's personal seal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required sea-eagle tally tokens to bear the founding emperor's personal seal.

sentences.zh: 庚申，奉御九住舊以梳櫛奉太祖，奉所落須發束上，詔櫝之，藏於太廟夾室。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Palace Attendant Jiu Zhu, who had long used a comb in service to the Taizu and bound up the hair that fell from it, was ordered to place it in a casket and store it in a side chamber of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Palace Attendant Jiu Zhu, who had long served the Taizu with a comb and preserved the hair that fell from it, was ordered to enshrine the comb in a casket in a side chamber of the imperial ancestral temple.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "In all lawsuits, those who go into hiding or falsely accuse others shall receive the penalty for the crime they alleged."

translations.idiomatic: Guide was made a separate prefecture, with Su, Bo, Pi, and Xu detached and placed under it.

translations.idiomatic: Shen Prefecture was elevated to Nanyang Prefecture, with Tang, Deng, Yu, Song, and Ru placed under it.

translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was issued to Xijing.

translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the third month the Hedong-Shanxi surveillance commission was expanded, the Hedong-Shaanxi circuit was renamed Shaanxi-Sichuan circuit, and the Northern Mountains East-West circuit was renamed Northern Mountains Liaodong circuit.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "At New Year's Day, the imperial birthday, and court assemblies, all officials' memorials, foreign tribute, and envoys' audience and farewell ceremonies shall be handled by the Ceremonial Protocol Office."

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the salt revenue chief transport commissions of Shandong, Hejian, and Shaanxi circuits were renamed chief salt transport commissions.

translations.idiomatic: An edict, citing his evasive language and months of delay, refused.

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Xiayi County was restored, with Dangshan incorporated into it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Xiayi County was restored, with Dangshan incorporated into it.

translations.literal: Gushu was incorporated into Suiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gushu was merged into Suiyang.

translations.literal: Han Shi'an, wanhu of Bin-Di, was charged with privately storing grain, burning military equipment, falsely using relay horses, and on his own authority requesting Prince Tachar's allotment of four counties in Yidu, and other matters; the responsible offices repeatedly reported this. translations.idiomatic: Han Shi'an, wanhu of Bin-Di, was charged with hoarding grain, destroying military equipment, falsely using relay horses, and on his own authority requesting Prince Tachar's allotment of four Yidu counties, among other offenses; responsible offices had repeatedly reported him. translations.literal: On jiashen day, the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor went to Shangdu.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Xu Heng resigned secretariat duties citing old age and illness; he was made chancellor of the imperial academy and director of the imperial university. Heng returned his old salary, and an edict granted a new salary separately.

translations.idiomatic: An order established the national university, adding one vice director, one erudite, and one assistant erudite each, and selecting as students the sons and grandsons of Mongol and Han officials at court and of close attendants, together with outstanding youths.

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Mars transgressed the Western Rampart General in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Mars crossed the Western Rampart General in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Western Xia Zhongxing branch secretariat and other routes were established, with Chanhai made associate administrator of branch ministry affairs.

translations.idiomatic: " Nurse Zhao, wet nurse to the Prince of Yan, was enfeoffed as Lady of Bin State, and her husband Gong Delu was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Deyu.

translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

translations.idiomatic: Some thought it improper, but the Emperor said: "How fortunate to have produced a worthy person — let no one harbor jealousy."

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day five hundred thousand taels of silver were allocated for the Henan branch secretariat's annual expenses, and Xiangyang and Fancheng troops were ordered four dou of grain per man per month from then on.
