translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on guisi day the Minister of Agriculture reported: "Huduna, darughachi of Gaotang, prefect Zhang Tingrui, and vice-prefect Chen Siji were effective in promoting agriculture; Wang Zai, county magistrate of Shaan in Henan Prefecture, was remiss in promoting agriculture — promotions and demotions should be applied as encouragement and warning."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The recommendation was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The recommendation was accepted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，檀、順等州風潦害稼。

translations.literal: On jiwei day storms and flooding destroyed the crops in Tan, Shun, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day storms and flooding destroyed the crops in Tan, Shun, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 賜高麗至元九年曆。

translations.literal: Goryeo was granted the Zhiyuan 9 calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo was granted the Zhiyuan 9 calendar.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉朔，敕品官子孫儤直，敕遣阿魯忒兒等撫治大理。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day (xinyou), ranked officials' descendants were ordered to serve guard duty; Aru Te'er and others were dispatched to pacify Dali.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the first day (xinyou), ranked officials' descendants were ordered to serve guard duty, and Aru Te'er and others were dispatched to pacify Dali.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，罷諸路交鈔都提舉司。

translations.literal: On renxu day the directorate-generals for paper currency in all routes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the directorate-generals for paper currency in all routes were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，劉秉忠及王磐、徒單公履等言：「元正、朝會、聖節、詔赦及百官宣敕，具公服迎拜行禮。

translations.literal: On yihai day Liu Bingzhong, Wang Pan, Tushan Gonglu, and others submitted: "At New Year's Day, court assemblies, imperial birthdays, amnesties, and all hundred-official proclamations, officials should don formal robes to greet and perform obeisance."
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Liu Bingzhong, Wang Pan, Tushan Gonglu, and others submitted: "At New Year's Day, court assemblies, imperial birthdays, amnesties, and all hundred-official proclamations, officials should don formal robes to greet and perform obeisance."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was accepted.

sentences.zh: 禁行金《泰和律》。

translations.literal: Use of the Jin dynasty's Taihe Code was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Use of the Jin dynasty's Taihe Code was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 建國號曰大元，詔曰：

translations.literal: The dynastic name Great Yuan was established; the edict read:
translations.idiomatic: The dynastic name Great Yuan was established; the edict read:

sentences.zh: 誕膺景命，奄四海以宅尊；

translations.literal: Having received the glorious mandate, I embrace all within the four seas to dwell in supremacy;
translations.idiomatic: Having received the glorious mandate, I embrace all within the four seas and dwell in supremacy;

sentences.zh: 必有美名，紹百王而紀統。

translations.literal: A worthy name is necessary to continue the hundred kings and record the succession.
translations.idiomatic: A worthy name is necessary to continue the hundred kings and record the succession.

sentences.zh: 肇從隆古，匪獨我家。

translations.literal: This began from high antiquity and is not unique to my house alone.
translations.idiomatic: This began from high antiquity and is not unique to my house alone.

sentences.zh: 且唐之為言蕩也，堯以之而著稱；

translations.literal: Moreover, tang means "expansive," and Yao won renown thereby;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, tang means "expansive," and Yao won renown thereby;

sentences.zh: 虞之為言樂也，舜因之而作號。

translations.literal: yu means "rejoicing," and Shun took it as his style.
translations.idiomatic: yu means "rejoicing," and Shun took it as his style.

sentences.zh: 馴至禹興而湯造，互名夏大以殷中。

translations.literal: Down to Yu's rise and Tang's founding, they alternately named themselves Xia the Great and Yin the Central.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Yu's rise and Tang's founding, they alternately named themselves Xia the Great and Yin the Central.

sentences.zh: 世降以還，事殊非古。

translations.literal: As generations declined, the practice differed from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: As generations declined, the practice differed from antiquity.

sentences.zh: 雖乘時而有國，不以利而制稱。

translations.literal: Though they seized the moment to hold the realm, they did not craft their titles from profit.
translations.idiomatic: Though they seized the moment to hold the realm, they did not craft their titles from profit.

sentences.zh: 為秦為漢者，著從初起之地名；

translations.literal: Those called Qin and Han took names from the lands where they first rose;
translations.idiomatic: Those called Qin and Han took names from the lands where they first rose;

sentences.zh: 曰隋曰唐者，因即所封之爵邑。

translations.literal: Those called Sui and Tang drew from the fiefs they had been enfeoffed with.
translations.idiomatic: Those called Sui and Tang drew from the fiefs they had been enfeoffed with.

sentences.zh: 是皆徇百姓見聞之狃習，要一時經制之權宜，概以至公，不無少貶。

translations.literal: All of these catered to the people's familiar habits and served as stopgap measures for a time — weighed against perfect impartiality, they fall somewhat short.
translations.idiomatic: All of these catered to the people's familiar habits and served as stopgap measures for a time — weighed against perfect impartiality, they fall somewhat short.

sentences.zh: 我太祖聖武皇帝，握乾符而起朔土，以神武而膺帝圖，四震天聲，大恢土宇，輿圖之廣，歷古所無。

translations.literal: Our Taizu, the sage and martial emperor, grasped the mandate of Heaven and rose in the northern lands, took the imperial design through divine martial prowess, shook the four quarters with Heaven's thunder, and greatly expanded the realm — the breadth of the map is without precedent in history.
translations.idiomatic: Our Taizu, the sage and martial emperor, grasped the mandate of Heaven and rose in the northern lands, took the imperial design through divine martial prowess, shook the four quarters with Heaven's thunder, and greatly expanded the realm — the breadth of the map is without precedent in history.

sentences.zh: 頃者耆宿詣庭，奏章申請，謂既成於大業，宜早定於鴻名。

translations.literal: Recently venerable elders came to court and submitted memorials asking that, the great enterprise already accomplished, the august name should be fixed early.
translations.idiomatic: Recently venerable elders came to court and submitted memorials asking that, the great enterprise already accomplished, the august name should be fixed early.

sentences.zh: 在古制以當然，於朕心乎何有。

translations.literal: By ancient custom this is only fitting; in my own heart what objection could there be?
translations.idiomatic: By ancient custom this is only fitting; in my own heart what objection could there be?

sentences.zh: 可建國號曰大元，蓋取《易經》「乾元」之義。

translations.literal: Let the dynastic name be established as Great Yuan, taking the meaning of "Qian yuan" from the Book of Changes.
translations.idiomatic: Let the dynastic name be established as Great Yuan, taking the meaning of "Qian yuan" from the Book of Changes.

sentences.zh: 茲大冶流形於庶品，孰名資始之功；

translations.literal: Now the great forge pours form into the myriad things — who could name the merit of the primordial source?
translations.idiomatic: Now the great forge pours form into every creature — who could name the primordial source's merit?

sentences.zh: 予一人底寧於萬邦，尤切體仁之要。

translations.literal: I alone bring tranquillity to the myriad states, and am all the more intent on embodying benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: I alone bring peace to every realm, and am all the more intent on embodying benevolence.

sentences.zh: 事從因革，道協天人。

translations.literal: Affairs follow what is inherited and what is changed; the Way accords heaven and man.
translations.idiomatic: Government follows what is inherited and what must be changed; the Way keeps heaven and humanity in accord.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 稱義而名，固匪為之溢美；

translations.literal: Naming by what is right is assuredly not to heap excess praise upon it;
translations.idiomatic: To name the dynasty by its rightful meaning is certainly not to lavish undue praise;

sentences.zh: 孚休惟永，尚不負於投艱。

translations.literal: Trust in blessings is everlasting — still not to fall short in the hardship one has undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: May trust in blessings endure forever — and still not fall short in the hardship we have undertaken.

sentences.zh: 嘉與敷天，共隆大號。

translations.literal: Rejoice with all beneath heaven and together exalt the great designation.
translations.idiomatic: Rejoice with all under heaven and together exalt the great dynastic name.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置四川省於成都。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Sichuan Province was established at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Sichuan province was established at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 上都萬安閣成。

translations.literal: The Wanyan Pavilion at Shangdu was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Wanyan Pavilion at Shangdu was completed.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯朔，詔天下興起國字學。

translations.literal: On the xinmao new moon of the twelfth month, an edict ordered schools for the national script raised throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the twelfth month an edict ordered national-script schools established throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 宣徽院請以闌遺、漏籍等戶淘金，帝曰：「姑止，毋重勞吾民也。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendants Bureau requested that stray households, unregistered households, and the like be put to gold-panning; the Emperor said: "For now stop — do not overtax Our people again.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendants bureau asked to assign stray and unregistered households to gold-panning; the Emperor said, "Stop for now — do not burden Our people further.

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，減百官俸。

translations.literal: " On yisi day, officials' salaries were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: " On yisi day officials' salaries were reduced.

sentences.zh: 括西夏田。

translations.literal: Western Xia fields were surveyed.
translations.idiomatic: Fields in Western Xia were surveyed.

sentences.zh: 召塔出、董文炳赴闕。

translations.literal: Tachu and Dong Wenbing were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tachu and Dong Wenbing were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，並太常寺入翰林院，宮殿府入少府監。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was merged into the Hanlin Academy, and the Palace Repairs Directorate into the Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was merged into the Hanlin Academy and the palace repairs directorate into the directorate for imperial manufacturers.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔尚書省遷入中書省。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, an edict ordered the Ministry of State transferred into the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered the ministry of state moved into the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百九十四萬六千二百七十。

translations.literal: That year, households under heaven numbered 1,946,270.
translations.idiomatic: That year registered households numbered 1,946,270.

sentences.zh: 賜先朝后妃及諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例，賜囊家等羊馬價鈔萬千一百六十七錠。

translations.literal: Gold, silver, silk currency, and cloth were granted to the consorts of the previous reign and to the princes according to annual custom; 11,167 ingots of notes were granted to the Nangjia and others for sheep and horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: Former consorts and the princes received gold, silver, notes, and cloth as in annual custom; the Nangjia and others were granted 11,167 ingots of notes for sheep and horse prices.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪一百五人。

translations.literal: One hundred five persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred five persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月庚申朔，高麗國王王禃遣其臣禮賓卿宣文烈來賀，兼奉歲貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on the gengshen new moon, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his minister, Rites Reception Director Xuan Wenie, to offer congratulations and also deliver the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on the gengshen new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent Rites Reception Director Xuan Wenie with congratulations and the annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，並尚書省入中書省，平章尚書省事阿合馬、同平章尚書省事張易並中書平章政事，參知尚書省事張惠為中書左丞，參知尚書省事李堯咨、麥術丁並參知中書政事。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the Ministry of State was merged into the Central Secretariat; Ahmad, Equal-in-Rank Minister administering Ministry of State affairs, and Zhang Yi, Concurrent Equal-in-Rank Minister administering Ministry of State affairs, were both made Equal-in-Rank Grand Councillors of the Central Secretariat; Zhang Hui, Associate Administrator of Ministry of State affairs, was made Left Associate of the Central Secretariat; Li Yaozi and Maisuding, Associate Administrators of Ministry of State affairs, were both made Associate Administrators of Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the ministry of state was merged back into the Central Secretariat; Ahmad and Zhang Yi, equal-in-rank ministers of the ministry of state, were both made equal-in-rank grand councillors of the Central Secretariat; Zhang Hui became left associate of the Central Secretariat, and Li Yaozi and Maisuding became associate administrators of Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 罷給事中、中書舍人、檢正等官，仍設左右司，省六部為四，改稱中書。

translations.literal: The posts of supervising secretary, secretariat drafter, and reviewer were abolished; left and right sections were retained; the six ministries were reduced to four; and the designation was changed to Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretaries, secretariat drafters, and reviewers were abolished; left and right sections were kept; the six ministries were cut to four; and everything was renamed under the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔遣不花及馬璘諭高麗具舟糧助征耽羅。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict dispatched Buqa and Ma Lin to instruct Goryeo to furnish ships and grain to aid the campaign against Tamna.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict sent Buqa and Ma Lin to tell Goryeo to supply ships and grain for the Tamna campaign.

sentences.zh: 河南省請益兵，敕諸路簽軍三萬。

translations.literal: Henan Province requested additional troops; an edict ordered thirty thousand soldiers levied from various routes.
translations.idiomatic: Henan province asked for more troops; the court ordered thirty thousand men levied from the routes.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，敕皇子西平王奧魯赤、阿魯帖木兒、禿哥及南平王禿魯所部與四川行省也速帶兒部下，並忙古帶等十八族、欲速公弄等土番軍，同征建都。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Prince Orluk of Xi Ping, Aruq Temür, Töge, and the forces under Prince Tulu of Nan Ping, together with the Sichuan branch secretariat forces under Yesu Dai'er, the eighteen tribes of Mangudai, and the Tibetan troops of Yisuqongnong and others, to campaign jointly against Jiandu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered Prince Orluk of Xi Ping, Aruq Temür, Töge, and Prince Tulu of Nan Ping, together with Yesu Dai'er's Sichuan branch secretariat command, Mangudai's eighteen tribes, and the Tibetan troops under Yisuqongnong, to campaign jointly against Jiandu.

sentences.zh: 新安州初隸雄州，詔為縣入順天。

translations.literal: Xin'an Prefecture had originally been subordinate to Xiong Prefecture; an edict made it a county under Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Xin'an Prefecture, formerly subordinate to Xiong Prefecture, was made a county under Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，改北京、中興、四川、河南四路行尚書省為行中書省。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the branch ministries of state at the Beijing, Zhongxing, Sichuan, and Henan routes were changed to branch secretariats.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day branch ministries at the Beijing, Zhongxing, Sichuan, and Henan routes were renamed branch secretariats.

sentences.zh: 京兆復立行省，仍命諸王只必帖木兒設省斷事官。

translations.literal: Jingzhao again established a branch secretariat and also ordered Prince Jibiytemür to set up adjudication officers for the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: A branch secretariat was reestablished at Jingzhao and Prince Jibiytemür was ordered to appoint secretariat adjudication officers.

sentences.zh: 給西平王奧魯赤馬價弓矢，賜南平王禿魯銀印及金銀符各五。

translations.literal: Horse-price bows and arrows were granted to Prince Orluk of Xi Ping; Prince Tulu of Nan Ping was granted five silver seals and five each of gold and silver tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Orluk of Xi Ping received bows and arrows paid for at horse price; Prince Tulu of Nan Ping was granted five silver seals and five each of gold and silver tallies.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，移鳳州屯田於鹽、白二州。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, garrison-farming at Feng Prefecture was transferred to Yan and Bai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day garrison-farming at Feng Prefecture was moved to Yan and Bai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 敕董文炳時巡掠南境，毋令宋人得立城堡。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Dong Wenbing to patrol and raid the southern frontier from time to time and not let the Song erect fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dong Wenbing to patrol and raid the south periodically so the Song could not establish fortresses.

sentences.zh: 敕：「軍民訟田者，民田有餘則分之軍，軍田有餘亦分之民。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Where military and civilian households dispute fields, if civilian fields are surplus they shall be divided to the military; if military fields are surplus they shall likewise be divided to the civilians.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "In land disputes between military and civilian households, surplus civilian land goes to soldiers and surplus military land to civilians.

sentences.zh: 仍遣能臣聽其直，其軍奴入民籍者，還正之。

translations.literal: Capable officials are still to be sent to assess fair value; soldier-slaves entered into civilian registers shall be restored to their proper status.
translations.idiomatic: Competent officials were still to assess fair purchase prices, and soldier-slaves wrongly entered in civilian registers were to be restored.

sentences.zh: 」敕燕王遣使持香幡，祠嶽瀆、后土、五臺興國寺。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Prince of Yan to dispatch envoys bearing incense banners to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers, Earth Lord, and Xingguo Temple on Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Prince of Yan to send envoys with incense banners to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers, Earth Lord, and Xingguo Temple on Wutai.

sentences.zh: 命劉整總漢軍。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng was ordered to command the Han armies.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng was placed in overall command of the Han armies.

sentences.zh: 壬午，改山東東路都元帥府統軍司為行樞密院，以也速帶兒、塔出並為行樞密院副使。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the grand marshal's headquarters and army command of eastern Shandong route were changed to a branch privy council; Yesu Dai'er and Tachu were both made deputy commissioners of the branch privy council.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the eastern Shandong route grand marshal's army command was converted into a branch privy council; Yesu Dai'er and Tachu were both made its deputy commissioners.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，定受宣敕官禮儀。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the ritual for officials receiving imperial patents and edicts was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the ceremony for officials receiving imperial patents and edicts was fixed.

sentences.zh: 詔元帥府統軍司、總管萬戶府閱實軍籍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered grand marshal headquarters, army commands, and wanhu headquarters to verify military registers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered grand marshals' headquarters, army commands, and wanhu commands to verify military registers.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅朔，奉使日本趙良弼遣書狀官張鐸同日本二十六人，至京師求見。

translations.literal: Second month, on the gengyin new moon, Zhao Liangbi, envoy to Japan, sent document clerk Zhang Tuo together with twenty-six Japanese to the capital seeking audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the second month Zhao Liangbi, envoy to Japan, sent document clerk Zhang Tuo with twenty-six Japanese to the capital seeking audience.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔：「劄魯忽赤乃太祖開創之始所置，位百司右，其賜銀印，立左右司。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, an edict stated: "The jarquchi was established at the very founding by Taizu and ranks to the right of all offices; let him be granted a silver seal and establish left and right sections.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict stated, "The jarquchi post was created at Taizu's founding and ranks above all offices; grant it a silver seal and establish left and right sections.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，高麗國王王禃遣其臣齊安侯王淑來賀改國號。

translations.literal: " On renchen day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his minister, Marquis of Qi'an Wang Shu, to congratulate the change of dynastic name.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent Qi'an Marquis Wang Shu to congratulate the change of dynastic name.

sentences.zh: 改中都為大都。

translations.literal: Central Capital was changed to Great Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital was renamed Great Capital (Dadu).

sentences.zh: 甲午，命阿術典蒙古軍，劉整、阿裏海牙典漢軍。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Aju was ordered to command the Mongol armies; Liu Zheng and Ariq Haiya were ordered to command the Han armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Aju was placed in command of the Mongol armies and Liu Zheng and Ariq Haiya of the Han armies.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以去歲東平及西京等州縣旱蝗水潦，免其租賦。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, because Dongping and Western Capital prefectures and counties had suffered drought, locusts, and floods the previous year, their rents and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day rents and levies were remitted in Dongping and Western Capital prefectures and counties afflicted the previous year by drought, locusts, and flooding.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復唐州泌陽縣。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Biyang County in Tang Prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Biyang County in Tang Prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 建中書省署於大都。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat office was built at Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: A Central Secretariat office was built at Dadu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，始祭先農如祭社之儀。

translations.literal: On wushen day, sacrifice to the First Farmer began with the same rites as sacrifice to the Earth Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day sacrifice to the First Farmer began, using the same rites as the Earth Altar.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路開浚水利。

translations.literal: An edict ordered waterways dredged and opened in all routes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered waterways dredged throughout the routes.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor traveled to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，諭旨中書省，日本使人速議遣還。

translations.literal: Third month, on yichou day, an instruction was issued to the Central Secretariat that the Japanese envoys should be quickly discussed and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou day, the Central Secretariat was instructed to decide quickly on sending the Japanese envoys home.

sentences.zh: 安童言：「良弼請移金州戍兵，勿使日本妄生疑懼。

translations.literal: Antong said: "Liangbi requests transferring the garrison at Jin Prefecture so Japan will not groundlessly give rise to suspicion and fear.
translations.idiomatic: Antong said, "Zhao Liangbi asks to transfer the Jin Prefecture garrison so Japan does not take needless alarm.

sentences.zh: 臣等以為金州戍兵，彼國所知，若復移戍，恐非所宜。

translations.literal: We your ministers consider that the Jin Prefecture garrison is known to that country; if the garrison is moved again, I fear it would not be suitable.
translations.idiomatic: We think the Jin Prefecture garrison is known to them; moving it again would probably be unwise.

sentences.zh: 但開諭來使，此戍乃為耽羅暫設，爾等不須疑畏也。

translations.literal: Only openly instruct the envoys who have come that this garrison was temporarily established for Tamna; you need not suspect and fear.
translations.idiomatic: Only explain openly to the envoys that this garrison was set up temporarily for Tamna, and that they need not fear.

sentences.zh: 」帝稱善。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，括民間《四教經》，焚之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the Four Teachings Scripture among the people was collected and burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day copies of the Four Teachings Scripture among the people were seized and burned.

sentences.zh: 蒙古都元帥阿術、漢軍都元帥劉整、阿裏海牙督本軍破樊城外郛，斬首二千級，生擒將領十六人，增築重圍守之。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Aju of the Mongol armies, and Grand Marshals Liu Zheng and Ariq Haiya of the Han armies, supervised their forces in breaking the outer wall of Fan, beheading two thousand, capturing sixteen officers alive, and building up a heavier encirclement to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Aju of the Mongol armies and Grand Marshals Liu Zheng and Ariq Haiya of the Han armies led their forces in breaching Fan's outer wall, killing two thousand, capturing sixteen officers, and tightening the siege.

sentences.zh: 賑濟南路饑。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given in Jinan Route.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was sent to Jinan route.

sentences.zh: 詔免醫戶差徭。

translations.literal: An edict remitted corvée and miscellany for physician households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted physician households from corvée and miscellaneous levies.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，詔於土番、西川界立寧河驛。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jichou day, an edict ordered Ninghe Post established on the border between Tibetan and western Chuan territories.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jichou day, an edict ordered Ninghe Post set up on the Tibetan-western Chuan border.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜皇子愛牙赤所部馬。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, horses were granted to the command of Prince Aiyachi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day horses were granted to Prince Aiyachi's command.

sentences.zh: 丙午，給西平王奧魯赤所部米。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, grain was issued to the command of Prince Orluk of Xi Ping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day grain was issued to Prince Orluk of Xi Ping's command.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賑大都路饑。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, famine relief was given in Dadu Route.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day famine relief was sent to Dadu route.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午朔，立和林轉運司，以小雲失別為使，兼提舉交鈔使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the wuwu new moon, the Karakorum Transport Commission was established, with Xiao Yunshibie as commissioner, concurrently superintendent of note circulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the fifth month the Karakorum transport commission was established, with Xiao Yunshibie as commissioner and concurrent superintendent of note circulation.

sentences.zh: 己未，給闊闊出海青銀符二。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, two silver tallies for sea-hawks were granted to Kököchü.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Kököchü received two silver tallies for hunting hawks.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷簽回回軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the levy of Hui troops was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the draft of Hui troops was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，敕拔都軍於怯鹿難之地開渠耕田。

translations.literal: On guihai day, an edict ordered Batu's army to open canals and plow fields at Qielunan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered Batu's army to dig canals and farm at Qielunan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，簽徐、邳二州丁壯萬人戍邳州。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, ten thousand able-bodied men from Xu and Pi prefectures were levied to garrison Pi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day ten thousand able-bodied men from Xu and Pi prefectures were levied to garrison Pi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，減鐵冶戶，罷西蕃禿魯幹等處金銀礦戶為民。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, iron-smelting households were reduced; gold and silver mining households at Tibetan Tulugan and elsewhere were abolished and made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day iron-smelting households were reduced, and gold and silver mining households in Tibetan Tulugan and elsewhere were abolished and returned to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 禁漢人聚眾與蒙古人鬥毆。

translations.literal: Han people gathering in crowds to brawl with Mongols were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Han crowds brawling with Mongols were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 詔議取耽羅及濟州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered deliberation on taking Tamna and Jeju.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered deliberation on seizing Tamna and Jeju.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕修築都城，凡費悉從官給，毋取諸民，並蠲伐木役夫稅賦。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict ordered the capital walls built; all costs were to be paid entirely from official funds, nothing taken from the people, and the tax levies of woodcutting laborers were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered construction of the capital walls at full official expense with no levies on the people, and taxes on woodcutting laborers were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，敕諸路軍戶驅丁，除至元七年前從良入民籍者當差，余雖從良，並令助本戶軍力。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, an edict addressed soldier-household attendants in all routes: except those who before the seventh year of the Zhiyuan era had obtained freedom and entered civilian registers and thus owed corvée, though the rest had obtained freedom, all were ordered to assist their original households' military service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict addressed soldier-household attendants in all routes: only those freed and entered in civilian registers before Zhiyuan 7 owed corvée; the rest, though freed, still had to assist their original households' military service.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白犯畢距星。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Venus encroached on the star at the spacing of Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Venus passed the spacing star of Bi.

sentences.zh: 宮城初建東西華、左右掖門。

translations.literal: The palace city first built the Eastern and Western Hua gates and the Left and Right Flanking gates.
translations.idiomatic: The palace city first built the Eastern and Western Hua gates and the Left and Right Flanking gates.

sentences.zh: 詔安集答裏伯所部流民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered settlement of the displaced people under Darib.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the resettlement of displaced people under Darib.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，遣高麗國西京屬城諸達魯花赤及質子金鎰等歸國。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day, the various darughachis of Goryeo's Western Capital and dependent cities and hostages such as Jin Yi were sent home to their country.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month the darughachis of Goryeo's Western Capital and its dependent cities, with hostages including Jin Yi, were sent home.

sentences.zh: 減乞裏吉思屯田所入租，仍遣南人百名，給牛具以往。

translations.literal: Rents from the garrison farm at Qirghiz were reduced; one hundred southerners were still dispatched, furnished with oxen and tools, to go there.
translations.idiomatic: Rents from the Qirghiz garrison farm were reduced, and one hundred southerners were sent with oxen and tools.

sentences.zh: 是夜，京師大雨，壞墻屋，壓死者眾。

translations.literal: That night, heavy rain in the capital destroyed walls and houses; many were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: That night a great storm in the capital destroyed walls and houses and killed many.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，敕以籍田所儲糧賑民，不足，又發近地官倉濟之。

translations.literal: On guisi day, an edict used grain stored from the ceremonial field to relieve the people; when insufficient, nearby official granaries were also opened to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day grain from the ceremonial field stores was issued for relief; when that proved insufficient nearby official granaries were opened as well.

sentences.zh: 甲午，高麗告饑，轉東京米二萬石賑之。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Goryeo reported famine; twenty thousand shi of grain from Dongjing were transferred to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Goryeo reported famine, and twenty thousand shi of Dongjing grain was sent for relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，山東路行樞密院塔出於四月十三日遣步騎趨漣州，攻破射龍溝、五港口、鹽場、白頭河四處城堡，殺宋兵三百餘人，虜獲人牛萬計，第功賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Tachu of the eastern Shandong branch privy council, on the thirteenth day of the fourth month, sent infantry and cavalry toward Lian Prefecture, captured four fortresses at Shelonggou, Wugangkou, the salt works, and Baitou River, killed more than three hundred Song troops, captured people and cattle to the number of ten thousand, and graded merits and rewards in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Tachu of the eastern Shandong branch privy council reported that on the thirteenth of the fourth month he had sent infantry and cavalry toward Lian Prefecture, taken four fortresses at Shelonggou, Wugangkou, the salt works, and Baitou River, killed more than three hundred Song troops, captured people and cattle by the ten thousand, and graded rewards accordingly.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，高麗國王王禃請討耽羅余寇。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo requested to campaign against the remaining Tamna bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo asked to campaign against remaining Tamna bandits.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳朔，河南省臣言：「往歲徙民實邊屯耕，以貧苦悉散還家。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the dingji new moon, Henan provincial officials said: "In previous years people were relocated to garrison and farm the frontier borders; because of hardship they all dispersed and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingji new moon of the seventh month Henan provincial officials said, "Frontier resettlement and garrison farming had sent people back home in poverty.

sentences.zh: 今唐、鄧、蔡、息、徐、邳之民，愛其田廬，仍守故屯，願以絲銀準折輸糧，而內地州縣轉粟餉軍者，反厭苦之。

translations.literal: Now the people of Tang, Deng, Cai, Xi, Xu, and Pi love their fields and homes, still hold their old garrisons, and wish to deliver grain by conversion at silk and silver rates; yet the inland prefectures and counties that transport grain to supply the army find it on the contrary irksome.
translations.idiomatic: People in Tang, Deng, Cai, Xi, Xu, and Pi preferred their own fields, stayed at their old garrison farms, and offered to pay grain levies in silk or silver; inland prefectures and counties supplying troops by grain transport found the burden heavy.

sentences.zh: 臣議今歲沿邊州郡，宜仍其舊輸糧，內地州郡，驗其戶數，俾折鈔就沿邊和糴，庶幾彼此交便。

translations.literal: Your ministers propose that this year the frontier prefectures and commanderies should continue their old grain deliveries; inland prefectures and commanderies, according to their household numbers, should let them convert to notes and purchase grain along the frontier — thus both sides would find it mutually convenient.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that frontier prefectures keep delivering grain as before, while inland prefectures, by household count, pay notes to buy grain on the frontier — easing the burden on both sides.

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.literal: " An imperial decision stated: "Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor replied, "Approved.

sentences.zh: 」拘括開元、東京等路諸漏籍戶。

translations.literal: " Unregistered households in the Kaiyuan, Dongjing, and other routes were rounded up and registered.
translations.idiomatic: " Unregistered households in Kaiyuan, Dongjing, and other routes were rounded up and registered.

sentences.zh: 禁私鬻《回回曆》。

translations.literal: Private sale of the Hui calendar was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Private sale of the Hui calendar was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 賑水達達部饑。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given to the Udaid tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was sent to the Udaid tribe.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜諸王八八部銀鈔。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, paper notes were granted to the princes of the Babu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the princes of the Babu tribe received paper notes.

sentences.zh: 集都城僧誦《大藏經》九會。

translations.literal: Monks in the capital were assembled to recite the Great Canon in nine sessions.
translations.idiomatic: Monks in the capital were assembled for nine sessions of reciting the Great Canon.

sentences.zh: 壬午，和禮霍孫奏：「蒙古字設國子學，而漢官子弟未有學者，及官府文移猶有畏吾字。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Huluhuosun memorialized: "Schools for the Mongol script have been established in the national academy, yet children of Han officials still have no students enrolled; and in government documents there are still Uighur characters.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Huluhuosun memorialized, "National-script schools exist, but Han officials' sons are not enrolling, and government documents still use Uighur script.

sentences.zh: 」詔自今凡詔令並以蒙古字行，仍遣百官子弟入學。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that henceforth all edicts and orders use the Mongol script exclusively, and officials' sons were still sent to enroll in the schools.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered that henceforth all edicts use the Mongol script exclusively and that officials' sons be sent to school.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免徙大羅鎮居民，令倍輸租米給鷹坊。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, relocation of Daluo Fort residents was remitted; they were ordered to deliver double rent-grain to the hawk offices.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day relocation of residents from Daluo Fort was canceled; they were ordered to pay double rent-grain to the hawk offices instead.

sentences.zh: 詔分閱大都、京兆等處探馬赤奴戶名籍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered separate review of tammaqchi slave households' registers in Dadu, Jingzhao, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a separate review of tammaqchi slave-household registers in Dadu, Jingzhao, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the bingxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊子，立群牧所，掌牧馬及尚方鞍勒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the Herd Directorate was established, managing pasture horses and imperial saddles and bridles.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the herd directorate was established to manage pasture horses and imperial saddlery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，敕忙安倉及靖州預儲糧五萬石，以備弘吉剌新徙部民及西人內附者廩給。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered Mangan Granary and Jing Prefecture to store fifty thousand shi of grain in advance to supply provisions to newly relocated Hongjila tribespeople and westerners who had submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered fifty thousand shi stored in advance at Mangan Granary and Jing Prefecture to feed newly relocated Hongjila tribespeople and newly submitted westerners.

sentences.zh: 調兵增戍全羅州。

translations.literal: Troops were transferred to reinforce the garrison at Jeonla Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were redeployed to reinforce the garrison at Jeonla.

sentences.zh: 乙未，禁諸人以己事輒呼至尊稱號者。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, all persons who on their own affairs presumptuously called out the supreme honorific title were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day it was forbidden to use the supreme imperial title in private disputes.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，立斡脫所。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, an ordu office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an ordu office was established.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諸王闊闊出請以分地寧海、登、萊三州自為一路，與他王比，歲賦惟入寧海，無輸益都，詔從之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Prince Kuokuochu requested that his allotted territories Ninghai, Deng, and Lai Prefectures form their own circuit; compared with other princes, annual levies would enter only Ninghai and not be sent to Yidu — the edict granted this.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Prince Kuokuochu asked that his allotted Ninghai, Deng, and Lai prefectures be made a separate circuit; like other princes his annual levy would go only to Ninghai, not Yidu, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，千戶崔松敗宋襄陽援兵，斬其將張順，賜松等將士有差。

translations.literal: On guimao day, wanhu Cui Song defeated Song relief troops for Xiangyang, beheaded their general Zhang Shun, and Cui Song and other officers and soldiers were rewarded with silver and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day wanhu Cui Song defeated Song relief troops for Xiangyang, beheaded their general Zhang Shun, and Cui Song and his officers received silver and silk rewards in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丁未，改延州為延津縣，與陽武同隸南京。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Yan Prefecture was changed to Yanjin County and, together with Yangwu, placed under Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Yan Prefecture was made Yanjin County and, together with Yangwu, placed under Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賑遼東等路饑。

translations.literal: On guichou day, famine in Liaodong and other routes was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day relief was issued for famine in Liaodong and other routes.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，宋襄陽將張貴以輪船出城，順流突戰，阿術、阿剌海牙等舉烽燃火，燭江如晝，率舟師轉戰五十餘里，至櫃門關，生獲貴及將士二千餘人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiazi day, Song Xiangyang general Zhang Gui brought paddle-wheel ships out of the city and fought downstream in a sudden attack; Aju, Ala Haiya, and others raised beacons and lit fires, illuminating the river like day; they led the fleet in battle for more than fifty li to Guimen Pass and captured Zhang Gui alive along with more than two thousand officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the ninth month Song Xiangyang general Zhang Gui led paddle-wheel ships out of the city in a downstream attack; Aju, Ala Haiya, and others raised beacons and fires until the river shone like day, then led the fleet fifty li in battle to Guimen Pass and captured Zhang Gui alive with more than two thousand officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，敕樞密院：「諸路正軍帖戶及同籍親戚奴仆，丁年既長，依諸王權要以避役者，並還之軍，惟匠藝精巧者以名聞。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict to the Privy Council stated: "Among regular military households and registered kin and servant slaves in all routes, where adult males have sought exemptions through princes' influence to evade service, all are to be returned to the army; only those with refined craftsmanship may be reported by name."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict to the Privy Council ordered that adult males among regular military households and registered kin and slaves in all routes who had used princely influence to evade service be returned to the army; only those with exceptional craft skills might be reported by name.

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，同簽河南省事崔斌訟右丞阿裏妄奏軍數二萬，敕杖而罷之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Associate Branch Secretariat Signatory Cui Bin sued Right Vice Director Ali for falsely reporting twenty thousand troops; an edict ordered him beaten with the staff and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Cui Bin, associate signatory of the Henan branch secretariat, accused right vice director Ali of falsely reporting twenty thousand troops; an edict ordered Ali beaten with the staff and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷水軍總管府。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the Naval Marshal's Headquarters was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the naval marshal's headquarters was abolished.

sentences.zh: 東川元帥李吉等略地開州，拔石羊寨，擒宋將一人。

translations.literal: Eastern Chuan Marshal Li Ji and others raided Kai Prefecture territory, took Shiyang Stockade, and captured one Song general.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Chuan marshal Li Ji and others raided Kai Prefecture, took Shiyang Stockade, and captured a Song general.

sentences.zh: 統軍使合剌等兵掠合州及渠江口，獲戰船五十艘，賞銀幣有差。

translations.literal: Army Commander Hela and others raided He Prefecture and the Qijiang River mouth, seizing fifty war vessels; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Army commander Hela and others raided He Prefecture and the Qijiang estuary, seizing fifty war vessels; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，民夫三千人伐巨木遼東，免其家徭賦。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, three thousand civilian laborers were sent to cut giant timber in Liaodong, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day three thousand laborers were sent to cut giant timber in Liaodong, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太陰犯御女。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the moon infringed upon the Woman asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon infringed upon the Woman asterism.

sentences.zh: 賑益都路饑。

translations.literal: Famine in Yidu Route was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was issued for famine in Yidu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌朔，封皇子忙哥剌為安西王，賜京兆為分地，駐兵六盤山。

translations.literal: On the bingxu new moon in the tenth month of winter, the imperial son Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, granted Jingzhao as his allotment, and garrisoned troops at Liupan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the tenth month of winter Prince Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, given Jingzhao as his fief, and ordered to garrison Liupan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 遣使持詔諭扮卜、忻都國。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct the states of Banbu and Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent with an edict to instruct Banbu and Xindu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On renchen day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，趙璧為平章政事，張易為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Zhao Bi was made Grand Councillor and Zhang Yi was made Vice Director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Zhao Bi was made grand councillor and Zhang Yi vice director of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 乙未，築渾河堤。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the Hun River embankment was built.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Hun River embankment was built.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Mars infringed upon Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Mars infringed upon Saturn.

sentences.zh: 己亥，敕自七月至十一月終聽捕獵，余月禁之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, an edict permitted hunting from the seventh through the eleventh month and forbade it in the remaining months.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict permitted hunting from the seventh through the eleventh month and forbade it in the remaining months.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，立文州。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Wen Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Wen Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 初立會同館。

translations.literal: The Huitong Hostel was established for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: The Huitong Hostel was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯朔，詔以至元十年曆賜高麗。

translations.literal: On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month, an edict granted Goryeo the calendar of the tenth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month an edict granted Goryeo the calendar for the tenth year of Zhiyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，發北京民夫六千，伐木乾山，蠲其家徭賦。

translations.literal: On renxu day, six thousand civilian laborers were mobilized from Beijing to cut timber at Qianshan, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day six thousand Beijing laborers were sent to cut timber at Qianshan, and their families' corvée and levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 諸王只必帖木兒築新城成，賜名永昌府。

translations.literal: Prince Zhibi Temür's newly built city was completed and granted the name Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhibi Temür's newly built city was completed and named Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，蠲昔剌斡脫所負官錢。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, official debts owed by Cila Ot's ordu office were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day official debts owed by Cila Ot's ordu office were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon infringed upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon infringed upon Bi.

sentences.zh: 城光州。

translations.literal: Guang Prefecture was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: Guang Prefecture was fortified.

sentences.zh: 遣無籍軍掠宋境。

translations.literal: Unregistered troops were sent to raid Song territory.
translations.idiomatic: Unregistered troops were sent to raid Song territory.

sentences.zh: 己巳，敕發屯田軍二千、漢軍二千、高麗軍六千，仍益武衛軍二千，征耽羅。

translations.literal: On jisi day, an edict mobilized two thousand garrison-farming troops, two thousand Han troops, and six thousand Goryeo troops, augmenting them with two thousand Wuwei Guard troops, to campaign against Tamra.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict mobilized two thousand garrison-farming troops, two thousand Han troops, six thousand Goryeo troops, and two thousand additional Wuwei Guard troops to campaign against Tamra.

sentences.zh: 辛未，召高陵儒者楊恭懿，不至。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the Gaoling Confucian Yang Gongyi was summoned but did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Gaoling Confucian Yang Gongyi was summoned but refused to come.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以前拔樊城外郛功，賞千戶劉深等金銀符。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, for the earlier merit in taking Fancheng's outer wall, wanhu Liu Shen and others were rewarded with gold and silver tally seals.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, for merit in taking Fancheng's outer wall, wanhu Liu Shen and others received gold and silver tally seals.

sentences.zh: 己卯，並中書省左右司為一。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the Central Secretariat's left and right bureaus were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Central Secretariat's left and right bureaus were merged into one.

sentences.zh: 宋荊湖制置李庭芝為書，遣永寧僧賫金印、牙符，來授劉整盧龍軍節度使，封燕郡王。

translations.literal: Song Jinghu Military Commissioner Li Tingzhi wrote a letter and sent a Yongning monk bearing a gold seal and ivory tally to appoint Liu Zheng Military Commissioner of Lulong Army and enfeoff him as Prince of Yan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jinghu military commissioner Li Tingzhi wrote to Liu Zheng and sent a Yongning monk with a gold seal and ivory tally to appoint him military commissioner of the Lulong Army and enfeoff him as Prince of Yan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 僧至永寧，事覺，上聞，敕張易、姚樞雜問。

translations.literal: When the monk reached Yongning the affair was discovered and reported above; an edict ordered Zhang Yi and Yao Shu to conduct a joint inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: When the monk reached Yongning the plot was discovered and reported; an edict ordered Zhang Yi and Yao Shu to conduct a joint inquiry.

sentences.zh: 適整至自軍中，言：「宋患臣用兵襄陽，欲以是殺臣，臣實不知。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng had just arrived from the army and said: "The Song resent my campaigning at Xiangyang and wished to use this to kill me; I truly knew nothing of it."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng, just arrived from the army, said, "The Song resented my operations at Xiangyang and meant to use this to kill me; I truly knew nothing of it."

sentences.zh: 」敕令整為書復之，賞整，使還軍中，誅永寧僧及其黨友。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Liu Zheng to write a reply; he was rewarded and sent back to the army, and the Yongning monk and his accomplices were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Liu Zheng to write a reply, rewarded him, and sent him back to the army; the Yongning monk and his accomplices were put to death.

sentences.zh: 參知行省政事阿裏海牙言：「襄陽受圍久未下，宜先攻樊城，斷其聲援。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat Associate Ali Haiya said: "Xiangyang has been besieged for a long time without falling; we should first attack Fancheng and cut off its support."
translations.idiomatic: Branch secretariat associate Ali Haiya argued, "Xiangyang has been besieged long without falling; we should first attack Fancheng and cut off its relief."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 回回亦思馬因創作巨石炮來獻，用力省而所擊甚遠，命送襄陽軍前用之。

translations.literal: The Muslim Ismail invented a giant counterweight trebuchet and presented it; it required little force yet struck very far — an order sent it to the army before Xiangyang for use.
translations.idiomatic: The Muslim engineer Ismail invented a counterweight trebuchet and presented it; it required little effort yet cast very far, and an order sent it to the Xiangyang front for use.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉朔，詔諸路府州司縣達魯花赤管民長官，兼管諸軍奧魯。

translations.literal: On the yiyou new moon of the twelfth month, an edict ordered that in all routes the darughachi of prefectures, departments, and counties, while administering civilian chief officials, also administer the ordus of all armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the twelfth month an edict ordered route darughachis of prefectures, departments, and counties, while overseeing civilian chiefs, also to administer all army ordus.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立肅州等處驛。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, post stations at Suzhou and elsewhere were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day post stations were established at Suzhou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 以東平府民五萬餘戶復為東平路。

translations.literal: More than fifty thousand households of Dongping Prefecture were restored as Dongping Route.
translations.idiomatic: More than fifty thousand Dongping households were restored as Dongping Route.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，諸王忽剌出拘括逃民高麗界中，高麗達魯花赤上其事，詔高麗之民猶未安集，禁罷之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Prince Hulachu registered fugitive civilians within the Goryeo border; Goryeo's darughachi reported the matter, and an edict stated that Goryeo's people were still not settled — the practice was forbidden and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince Hulachu registered fugitive civilians in Goryeo; Goryeo's darughachi reported it, and an edict forbade the practice, saying Goryeo's people were still not settled.

sentences.zh: 遣宋議互市使者南歸。

translations.literal: Song envoys discussing mutual trade were sent south to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Song envoys discussing mutual trade were sent home to the south.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜北平王南木合軍馬一萬二千九百九十一、羊六萬一千五百三十一，及諸王塔察兒軍幣帛。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Prince of Beiping Nanmuhe was granted twelve thousand nine hundred ninety-one army horses and sixty-one thousand five hundred thirty-one sheep, and Prince Tachar was granted military silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Nanmuhe of Beiping received twelve thousand nine hundred ninety-one army horses and sixty-one thousand five hundred thirty-one sheep, and Prince Tachar received military silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宋將昝萬壽來攻成都，簽省嚴忠範出戰失利，退保子城，同知王世英等八人棄城遁。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Song general Zan Wanshou came to attack Chengdu; Branch Secretariat Yan Zhongfan went out to fight but was defeated, withdrew to hold the inner city, and Associate Wang Shiying and seven others abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Song general Zan Wanshou attacked Chengdu; branch secretariat Yan Zhongfan fought and lost, withdrew to the inner city, and associates Wang Shiying and seven others abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 詔以邊城失守，罪在主將，世英雖遁，與免其罪，惟遣使縛忠範至京師。

translations.literal: An edict stated that with the border city lost the guilt lay with the chief commander; though Wang Shiying had fled, he was exempted from punishment, and only envoys were sent to bind Yan Zhongfan and bring him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that with the border city lost the fault lay with the chief commander; though Wang Shiying had fled he was pardoned, and only Yan Zhongfan was bound and brought to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，升拱衛司為拱衛直都指揮使司。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Arch Guard Office was promoted to Arch Guard Direct Command Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Arch Guard Office was promoted to the Arch Guard Direct Command Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百九十五萬五千八百八十。

translations.literal: That year, registered households empire-wide numbered one million nine hundred fifty-five thousand eight hundred eighty.
translations.idiomatic: That year registered households empire-wide numbered one million nine hundred fifty-five thousand eight hundred eighty.

sentences.zh: 賜先朝后妃及諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Empresses of former reigns and princes were granted gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Empresses of former reigns and princes received gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪三十九人。

translations.literal: Thirty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-nine persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 建大聖壽萬安寺。

translations.literal: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple was built.
